## Purpose

Describe the problem and the smallest safe change.

## Safety impact

- [ ] This change does not increase the immutable 10-contract size.
- [ ] This change does not increase the immutable 1¢ economic price.
- [ ] This change does not add a mutation route.
- [ ] This change does not weaken dry-run, kill-switch, credential, manifest, ledger, or authorization gates.
- [ ] New or changed behavior has regression coverage.

## Verification

- [ ] `python -m unittest discover -s tests -v`
- [ ] `ruff check run_bot.py kalshi_public scripts tests`
- [ ] `python -m pip check`
- [ ] `python run_bot.py verify --ci`
- [ ] No credentials, account data, runtime state, or generated attestations are included.

## Documentation and release integrity

- [ ] Relevant documentation was updated.
- [ ] `FILE_INVENTORY.txt` and `MANIFEST.sha256` will be regenerated by the release owner after approval.
- [ ] The licensing status in `LICENSE.md` is unchanged unless the rights holder explicitly approved the change.
